Regulated entities shall ensure cross-border payment data is transmitted using encrypted methods (e.g., TLS 1.2+, IPsec) and authenticated interfaces.
Cardholder data shall be tokenized or encrypted at rest or in transit.
All remote access communication and sessions shall be encrypted end-to-end using latest security protocols (e.g., VPN, mTLS).
